# BottomSheet

A sheet that rises from the bottom on mobile and becomes a centred dialog on desktop, used for add task, confirmations and break prompts.

`CLR.BottomSheet` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.BottomSheet open title="…" onClose={…}>…</CLR.BottomSheet>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.BottomSheet" open="{{yes}}" title="…" on-close="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Props (BottomSheetProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Footer buttons; the primary one goes last (right / bottom). |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | At ≥768px the sheet renders as a centred dialog. |
